channel.title: Pier & Point · 1401 Third Street
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for 1401 Third Street (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · 1401 Third Street: 1401 Third Street now uses its Assessor lot lines.
item.description: 1401 Third Street now uses its Assessor lot lines. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lot 8721032.

item.title: Correction · 1401 Third Street: The map notes cited a CBRE listing for a different building (1455 3rd St) as a source; it was removed, and the Assessor roll for parcel 8721032 is now cited for the size, year built and office use. The record's permit source said the permit completed on 2008-04-24; the permit record says 2009-11-17, so that was corrected everywhere it appeared. The claim that 455 Mission Bay Blvd South was this parcel's address before a renaming is now stated as our inference from the permit's location, and the summary says Mission Bay instead of Mission Bay South.

item.title: Planned · 1401 Third Street: SF Dept. of Building Inspection permit #200704279921 filed to erect a 5-story office/lab building at 455 Mission Bay Blvd South (block 8721, lot 012); its mapped point is about 6 m from the Assessor point for this parcel (1401 Third Street, lot 032), which is our inference for linking the two, not stated by any source (Apr 27, 2007)
